## Validations

These checks describe how aNCA is tested and what it checks before export.

-   **Code coverage \>90%.** You can check this either in our [GitHub README badge](https://github.com/pharmaverse/aNCA) or by running yourself `covr::package_coverage()` in our repository (after cloning)
-   **CI/CD workflow passing.** Testing package installation on Ubuntu (22.04) & Windows (latest), unit function tests and general documentation aspects (completeness, spelling...)
-   **Export checks.** Before saving, aNCA checks the structure of selected exports and checks column types and lengths for selected CDISC datasets. Error findings stop the export.
-   **Historical validation report.** Roche’s report covers aNCA v0.1.0.9004. See the [report](https://github.com/pharmaverse/aNCA/blob/main/inst/extras/validation_reports/v0.1.0-roche-report.pdf) and the [validation methodology](https://pharmar.org/posts/case-studies/roche-case-study/).
-   **PK calculations.** aNCA calculates pharmacokinetic parameters using [PKNCA](https://github.com/humanpred/pknca).

If you feel something is missing or have ideas on how to improve the validation process, we’d love to hear your feedback, check [this issue](https://github.com/pharmaverse/aNCA/issues/539) and comment!

## Potential new validations

Among our plans will be to:

-   **Automate CI/CD CDISC standard testings** in the outputs
-   **Polish our end-to-end Shiny App tests** (there is an ongoing draft)
-   **Consider other testing types**: fuzzing, chaos, sensibility...
-   **Assess risk in our CI/CD using OS tools** with metrics based on popular packages created for this
-   **Join CRAN** to increase the number of users testing the App
-   **Improve App documentation** (i.e, tutorials) so new users can test all the App options
